responsibility: This definition module declares fixed-format input/output and string conversion routines for floating-point and long-integer values in the gm2 base libraries. It belongs to the numeric formatting subsystem and exports read/write and array-string conversion APIs for REAL, LONGREAL, and LONGINT, complementing the ordinal-focused NumberIO module.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface/specification file for floating-point and long-integer textual I/O, declaring the read/write and string-conversion routines; the actual conversions via StrIO and StringConvert are implemented in FpuIO.mod.
